title: Kissed Sweet Thai Coconut Kanom Ko
description: A sweet and aerated Thai dish featuring high heat cooking oil and stone bowl dolsot, low in calories and perfect for a comforting snack.
instructions: Preheat the stone bowl dolsot over high heat until it reaches 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the rice flour, palm sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the coconut oil to the preheated dolsot and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Pour the batter into the dolsot and cook for 2 minutes, until the bottom is golden brown.
Loosen the kanom ko with a spatula and flip it over to cook for another 2 minutes.
Remove the kanom ko from the dolsot and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve the kissed sweet Thai coconut kanom ko warm and enjoy.
